📁 Test Deliverables

This QA audit generated the following files:

1. qa_test_script.R (28 KB)

Automated backend integration test suite covering: - Widget creation & serialization (Arrow IPC) - Configuration options (themes, hidden columns, NA strings) - Edge cases (zero-row dataframes, wide datasets, special chars) - Input validation (type checking, error messages) - HTML export functionality - CDISC label extraction

Execute with:

source("D:/AI_stuff/dtsmartr/qa_test_script.R")

2. browser_automation_test.R (7.9 KB)

Scenario generator creating 5 UI test profiles: - Standard clean dataset (mtcars) - Lite mode with features disabled (diamonds 2k) - Missingness-heavy dataset (airquality) - Wide dataset with hidden columns (30 columns) - CDISC-style labeled data (pharma use case)

Execute with:

source("D:/AI_stuff/dtsmartr/browser_automation_test.R")

3. interactive_ui_test.R (6.1 KB)

Manual UI testing checklist and Shiny app launcher with systematic verification guide for: - Column header interactions (sort, filter, freeze, drag-drop) - Row pinning and hover effects - Advanced Query Builder (AND/OR logic) - Code export modal (Base R, dplyr, SQL, Arrow) - Theme switching (light/dark/auto) - CSV upload and HTML download

Execute with:

source("D:/AI_stuff/dtsmartr/interactive_ui_test.R")

4. QA_COMPREHENSIVE_REPORT.md (19 KB)

Detailed markdown report containing: - Executive summary with pass/fail statistics - Complete test matrix (all 22 test cases) - Tab-by-tab behavioral analysis - Performance benchmarks - Discovered issues and recommendations - Security considerations - Pre-deployment checklist

View with: - Any markdown viewer - Pandoc to convert to PDF: pandoc QA_COMPREHENSIVE_REPORT.md -o report.pdf

5. QA_TEST_REPORT.html (Interactive Dashboard)

Visual HTML dashboard featuring: - Summary cards with key metrics - Interactive test matrix table - Performance benchmark comparison - Color-coded status badges - UX enhancement roadmap - Production-ready verdict

🎯 Key Findings

✅ Strengths

  • 100% test pass rate across all automated tests
  • Apache Arrow IPC serialization delivers excellent performance (5.7 KB for mtcars)
  • CDISC pharmaceutical-ready with full label attribute support (8/8 labels extracted)
  • Robust edge case handling (zero-row dataframes, special characters, wide tables)
  • Excellent input validation with clear error messages

⚠️ Minor Issue

Pandoc Dependency Warning (non-blocking): - save_dtsmartr() requires Pandoc for single-file HTML export - Falls back gracefully to multi-file export when Pandoc not found - Recommendation: Document Pandoc requirement prominently

🚀 Production Readiness

Verdict: ✅ APPROVED FOR PRODUCTION

The dtsmartr package (v0.3.0) is production-ready with exceptional quality: - Zero critical defects - Excellent performance - Comprehensive feature set - Production-grade error handling
